newsitems.title: Team Falcons' Finale
newsitems.author: COMPLEX
newsitems.contents:
[p][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/97e2906ad1381f57c881ca5049649e1d38001ac3.jpg[/img]Taking on the toughest Playoff bracket in Major history, the Falcons made a triumphant statement at the IEM Cologne 2026 Major.

Facing the defending Major Champions in the Quarterfinals, Falcons defeated Vitality 2-1, with each map taking 24 rounds to determine a winner. The Semifinals weren't any easier, where the Falcons met Team Spirit in a best of three that saw two maps go to Overtime. In the end, the Falcons outlasted Team Spirit 16:12 on Dust II, taking the series 2-1 and booking their first appearance in the Grand Finals. 

In the Grand Finals the Falcons left no doubt, defeating FURIA 3-0 to claim the organization's first Major Championship.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/1a646666feb18ff678ffee27f43faa3c8b0e1560.png[/img]
To celebrate the closing of the Cologne Major, new items are available in the Major Shop: the IEM Cologne 2026 Champions Autograph stickers (featuring Paper, Holo, Foil, and Gold autographs from Falcons players), and IEM Cologne 2026 Highlight Charms (featuring 10 highlights for each of the six stages of the Cologne 2026 Major, and the Falcons' trophy-lifting moment.)

Congratulations to the Falcons, champions of the Cathedral and champions of the IEM Cologne 2026 Major![/p]

newsitems.title: The Dark Carnival
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/7942925df6ae43659acf60f2d2ff827461c02485.png[/img]

Don't you hate it when you wake up in a prison car with no memory of how you got there and, worse, no way to escape, only to discover you've been captured by an evil puppet-man as part of some dark bargain with an ancient world-conquering evil? We've all been there.

We're pulling back the curtain on [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnival]the Dark Carnival[/url], a new ongoing event in the Dota universe. This first part, "Midnight Run", lets you navigate Legion Commander and Hoodwink through a massive, fully-voiced Dota story featuring a spider-legged convoy of deadly robots, heartstopping secrets, and unique rewards.

Today's update features five all-new Automaton Personas (mechanical reimaginings of classic Dota heroes with new animations, effects, icons, and more), 20 new hero sets (some in a brand new treasure, and some that can only be earned by exploring the map and story), and much more. There's [url=http://dota2.com/darkcarnivalcomic]a comic[/url] if you're the kind of person who likes backstory.

But if, much like Legion Commander and Hoodwink themselves, you'd prefer to be thrown into the action without a lot of pesky memories of how you wound up in Ringmaster's prison train, the first stage of Midnight Run is now live in-game and free for all players. This is just the beginning: There are plenty of surprises in Midnight Run, and we're just getting started.

You couldn't play him, and his spot in the lineup was replaced by the sort of poster you might find asking for help finding a missing person. All of a sudden, however, Axe has returned, just as quickly as he left... but something's not quite right.

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d1ef0da1959ac5b383fbf357a2b9af071015cef5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Season 04 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]Lock Into Summer[/h3][p][/p][p]This summer, there’s no break in the heat as an unexpected hero leads the action across all four modes. Unlock and play as Nick Cage across new and returning Multiplayer maps and modes guaranteed to make you sweat. But it’s not time to cool off yet. End The Guild’s dominance in Avalon once and for all in Endgame’s new Operation King Killer, fight in a Japanese feudal castle engulfed by lava in the new Kowakujō Round-Based Zombies map and prove your status as an elite action hero with the return of the Champion’s Quest in Core Battle Royale.[/p][p][/p][p]Summer’s heating up and with Season 04 Reloaded, the temperature is downright sizzling. Gear up and face the inferno when the Mid-Season update arrives in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone™ on June 25 at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="W824eTd2bFc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operation King Killer:[/b] The Guild’s defenses are down as JSOC breaches the company firewall. Pinpoint the location of the Central Command Node and destroy it in Operation King Killer, delivering ten escalating challenges in Zone III and higher. Unlock new rewards and complete the Operation with Samuels, Wei Lin, or Emma Kagan to earn a new Weapon Camo, and with all three to access a new Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, New Skills & Minor Ability:[/b] Stand up to the most punishing combat encounters with the new Guardian Skill Track, transforming your Operator into a frontline anchor. Unlock a new Exotic Skill and Nightmare Skill and brain-rot your foes with the hallucinogenic effects of the new Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free to Play Continues:[/b] Play Endgame for free through the end of Season 05. Invite your friends to join the squad and level up and earn rewards through the co-operative game mode’s multiple Operations.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Act IV: Operation King Killer (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e682a5f328205e200d13939823a1c66eb8516de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Time to end this, once and for all. The Guild’s Central Command Node has been revealed. Collect Command Data throughout Avalon to pinpoint its source and destroy it.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In Act III, The Guild struck back against JSOC’s attempts to deploy a virus against their network, but through the efforts of Operators on the ground, the location of the Central Command Node was finally revealed. With the Guild network now fully exposed, it’s the perfect time to strike.[/p][p][/p][p]But it won’t be easy. From Step 1, Operation King Killer kicks things off with missions in Zone III or higher, starting with vehicular combat as Operators scour Avalon for anomalous data and other intel sources to help track down the location of the physical terminal housing the Command Node.[/p][p]  [/p][p]Earn new rewards as you complete the various Operation objectives, all while further empowering your Operator through additional CR gains.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the final step, acquire access to the new Prime Target Glitch and face the Glitch Boss. Operation rewards include a new Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, Double XP Token, Restore Token, Loading Screen, and more, detailed below. [/p][p][/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ddd3ed9d09968f6ed4561ca034bf5dbb03d9ec45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Reach the final step of Operation King Killer to gain access to the Prime Target Glitch. Beat back a flood of enemies in a Nightmare Difficulty zone culminating in a ruthless boss fight.[/p][p][/p][p]Defeat the Prime Target Glitch Boss in the final step with Samuels, Wei Lin, or Emma Kagan to earn the unique “Data Freeze” Operator Skin.[/p][p][/p][p]Act IV Completion Rewards: [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Data Freeze” Operator Skin to unlock the “End of Daze” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn all 3 “Data Freeze” Operator Skins to access the “End of Dayz” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Operation King Killer Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62334b016428ec541250afb481dc7ab965af74b4.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]“Decompression” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Last Breath” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Upper Limit” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dutybound” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Hot Hands” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Coolant Leak” Weapon Blueprint, “To the Grave” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Psych Grenade, and More[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/249e5ed57dcb5975fb5f22468edacdaa74782e48.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since the launch of Season 04, Operators have been decimating Guild and hallucinatory forces across Avalon wielding the new Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, shrug off heavy attacks with the new Guardian Skill Track and inflict brain-rot on foes with the new Psych Grenade. Position the lingering cloud near chokepoints and enemy groups for maximum effectiveness.[/p][p][/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Payback:[/b] Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p][b]Battle Cache:[/b] Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p][b]Power Tap:[/b] Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p][b]Fortified:[/b] Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p][b]Iron Grip:[/b] Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse:[/b] If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade[/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]New Exotic Skill: Fission[/p][p][i]Killing an elite has the chance to trigger a large explosion, dealing massive damage to nearby enemies.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Upgrade this new Exotic Skill for increased damage and radius of your explosions and deploy a final upgrade to spawn friendly Toxic Fears from those explosions.[/p][p][/p][p]New Nightmare Skill: Sleeper Agent[/p][p][i]Chance on hit to turn base enemies into allies that rush nearby hostiles and detonate on impact.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Upgrade the newest Nightmare Skill to attract enemies to the Sleeper Agent, and with a final upgrade, the Sleeper Agent will drop cluster munitions to expand the damage radius.[/p][p][/p][h3]Free to Play Through Season 05[/h3][p][/p][p]Endgame will remain free to play until the end of Season 05. Jump in and dominate across Avalon while powering up your Operator with unique combat abilities that encourage you to push into more challenging zones. Play now to earn Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and other in-game rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 04 Reloaded Multiplayer[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] In Zenith, deploy to a luxurious cliffside compound where a bloody handprint marks a secret passage to the running water below. Plus, prepare for Launch, originally released in the original Call of Duty: Black Ops and newly remastered for Black Ops 7![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Adapt or die in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter where Weapon Blueprints rotate throughout the match, testing your ability to change tactics on the fly while gaining bonuses for elimination streaks. For a close-quarters challenge, drop the ranged weapons and compete in Knife Fight. Black Ops Classic also becomes a permanent addition, with four more maps added to the rotation.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p]Zenith[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0592d0d275ce8b777b15d2f5d2fc1193a44e98ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In a last-ditch effort to reverse JSOC’s gains, The Guild assaults Karma’s sanctuary hidden deep in the jungle. The extravagant compound features everything the expert hacker needs, from state-of-the-art tech and security systems to high end art and breathtaking architecture. In the aftermath of the attack, an armored vehicle lies burning and overturned at the Entrance, a trail of blood leading into the main Office.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53c24623955f2c9802d3fd990241fdf9d6634545.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight within the building or enjoy the view along the main flanking paths on either side, whether you’re traversing the edge of the cliff or taking the upper ground. For greater concealment, try your luck in the running water beneath the compound… but get out when the alarm starts blaring and the red lights flash, a sure sign that you’re about to get swept off the brink.[/p][p][/p][p]Launch[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9829aa0026b2e5e3392a443b507a51c4966d69ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to a Russian rocket launch facility in Launch, returning from the original Call of Duty: Black Ops. At the start of the match, witness the massive rocket being lifted and moved into position over the Launch Pad, preparing for takeoff near the halfway point of the match. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eee462a542b61da428f6938268b0aed568b8d02d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the Loading zone and Launch Pad, the sprawling facility includes an expansive Fuel Yard, Storage, and the main Road connecting various supporting structures and interior spaces. The complex layout of industrial features provides plentiful cover points and flanking paths and prime sniping spots up the Launch Pad staircases. No matter what your playstyle, there’s a place for it here. Gear up, drop in, and prepare for takeoff.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p]Team Blueprint Sharpshooter[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f62afd4e9005856c855095944f81d49b66921052.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Weapons cycle every 45 seconds. Eliminate enemies to earn score. Earn bonus abilities and 2x score for elimination streaks.[/p][p][/p][p]Adapt and slay in this 6v6 playlist featuring cycling Loadouts with Weapon Blueprints like the Heart-Stopper NX Ravager, Search Party MPC-25 SMG, the dual-wield Deadend Coda 9 Pistols, and other incredible Blueprints across the Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapon slots.[/p][p][/p][p]Push the attack and earn power-ups for kill streaks, speeding up your combat movements and unlocking a double score multiplier at a five-streak. The exact Operator bonuses are as follows: [/p][p][/p][p]1-Streak: Faster movement speed.[/p][p]2 -Streak: Faster reload speed.[/p][p]3-Streak: Faster sprint recovery.[/p][p]4-Streak: Faster aim down sights speed.[/p][p]5-Streak: Double score.[/p][p][/p][p]Use every tool at your disposal and don’t forget that Equipment renews with every weapon swap as well. Toss your throwables, open fire, and be the first team to reach the score limit to win the match.[/p][p][/p][p]Knife Fight[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1867d27302e1a9417a1a92a0deacb7b55b9d745d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Eliminate all enemy players using pre-determined classes to win the round. No respawns.[/p][p][/p][p]Engage in 2v2 hand-to-hand combat in this close-quarters variant of Gunfight. From the H311-SAW to the Flatline MK.II and, naturally, the Knife and Ballistic Knife, Knife Fight challenges Operators to engage in an epic melee brawl.[/p][p][/p][p]There are no Scorestreaks or Field Upgrades here, and ranged weapons are restricted except for the Equipment items granted to players a few seconds into the round and the Ballistic Knife when it’s chosen as the round’s main weapon. The first duo to win six rounds wins the match. Drop in and start slashing.[/p][p][/p][p]As an added bonus, players who acquire 10 Double Kills in Knife Fight will unlock the “Combatant” Weapon Charm.[/p][p][/p][p]Black Ops Classic[/p][p]New Updates[/p][p][/p][p]The popular throwback mode becomes a permanent addition to Black Ops 7 with Season 04 Reloaded, along with four more iconic maps from previous Black Ops titles joining the rotation. Starting on June 25, Black Ops Classic players can enjoy Launch (Black Ops), Fringe (Black Ops 3), Hacienda (Black Ops 4), and Gridlock (Black Ops 4).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 04 Reloaded Zombies[/u] [/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Round-Based Zombies Map — Kowakujō:[/b] To save the material world and free the last Shadowsmith, the crew makes a harrowing journey to a feudal Japanese castle in the Dark Aether, surrounded by volcanoes and drowning in fire. This is Kowakujō, the next Round-Based Zombies map launching with Season 04 Reloaded.  [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Enemies, Wonder Weapon:[/b] Engage in battle with the supernatural Oni, wielding a kanabō war club and the power of the Heavens, while evading fire-drenched Hellhounds and Scorched Zombies, eager to immolate the crew with searing attacks. Enlist the help of a mystical new Wonder Weapon, an additional legacy weapon in the Mystery Box, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Features:[/b] Add additional firepower to your squad with the Legendary Hellping Hound GobbleGum, summoning the assistance of a Hellhound against the undead forces. Tackle the Main Quest for XP and rewards and push the challenge in Cursed to unlock new Pack-a-Punch Camos, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Map: Kowakujō[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58c78486d4717108ec5c8df85a888eb38f1da0cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]“This place looks like my home, but it is... off. Like a painting created from memory. — Takeo Masaki[/p][p][/p][p]As the crew discovered in Totenreich, the Dark Aether is unraveling, the consequences of which would spell catastrophe for the material world. The crew must now free the final Shadowsmith and recover the mysterious World Seed.[/p][p][/p][p]Their quest takes them to the fractured slopes of a volcanic landscape where a crumbling castle harbors a smoldering mystery. Their mission? Face Nyxara’s undead army, liberate the Shadowsmith, and expose the curse that grips Takeo’s soul. [/p][p][/p][p]Kowakujō: In the Dragon’s Maw[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/240f09cb46d314e353fef660d65e581752f840ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]En route to their destination, the crew nearly succumbs to a scorching end as their rocky platform crumbles away in a river of fire, the undead horde throwing themselves at the desperate protagonists. As the situation becomes dire, a dragon soars overhead, looking for its next meal.[/p][p][/p][p]The crew escapes just in time, landing in the Outer Ward. Explore the burning castle, face off against the horde within, and recover Takeo and Carver’s souls...[/p][p][/p][p]Kowakujō: New Enemy: Oni[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/afa042591fb4f225a65ab19f8d013ec113d74a87.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Steel your nerves and prepare to fight for your life when the Oni fixes on you with its glowing gaze. The yōkai embodies wrath and malice, and its pursuit of its foes is relentless, striking targets with a massive spiked kanabō while shrugging off blows with its heavy armor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/25f95dec86132a9a60522d7438b855ac9b411325.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With the power of electricity at its fingertips, the Oni will sometimes electrify its melee weapon before launching into a powerful area of effect attack. And don’t assume that running will keep you out of reach, as it can fire electric bolts at distant enemies. When there’s an Oni on the field, there’s only one response at hand: Unload with everything you’ve got.[/p][p][/p][p]As if the Oni isn’t terrifying enough, the crew must also contend with Hellhounds and Scorched Zombies. These fiery enemies seek to immolate their targets, so keep your distance until they’ve burned out.[/p][p] [/p][p]Kowakujō: New Wonder Weapon[/p][p]Send the flaming undead back to their graves with a mystical new Wonder Weapon. What form will it take? Discover for yourself when Season 04 Reloaded begins...[/p][p]  [/p][p]Kowakujō: Ghostly Rifleman Trap[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/995e0cc8fdb0bc6e1cb9d7bba669d43ef8b6fe7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Shred zombies with ghostly riflemen.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Not all the spirits in Takeo’s childhood home are bound to the Warden’s will. Look for the dual komainu statues guarding many of the doorways throughout Kowakujō and marked with the trap icons on the mini-map. Once the power is on, activate the trap to call upon the castle’s long-dead riflemen, more than willing to lend their fire support against the ravenous horde.[/p][p][/p][p]Kowakujō: Rivers of Fire[/p][p]Watch your step while traversing the castle’s searing grounds. Those rivers of lava aren’t just part of the décor; dip your toes in, and the molten rock will immediately sear your skin and slow you down. Enemies also take some damage here, so use the fire to your advantage while keeping your feet well clear. But beware, as zombies who stay in it too long will become Scorched Zombies![/p][p][/p][p]Kowakujō: New Main Quest, Quest Rewards, and Challenges[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/340978a2b3bff6c0e2e3df4725a0305301a32d36.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Main Quest for Kowakujō will be available when the map releases with Season 04 Reloaded on June 25 at 9AM PT. Complete the Main Quest to earn the following:[/p][list][*][p]The “Purified” Takeo Operator Skin, Calling Card, and 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Obtain the necessary Intel (Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts) to earn a third Calling Card and another 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for this map will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Complete the Kowakujō Mastery Challenge to earn an Animated Calling Card and 10,000 XP. The map challenges (each awarding XP and static Calling Cards upon completion) are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Obsidian Sins: Complete 25 Rounds on Kowakujō.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[Redacted]: Eliminate 25 zombies in five seconds using the Wonder Weapon 25 times on Kowakujō.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Onied: Earn 10 Duelist Medals (Kill a Charged Oni with a Melee Weapon).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Citadel: Upgrade the Ghostly Rifleman trap on Kowakujō.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Par Course: Complete the Obstacle Course on Kowakujō.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Neko Café: Find all of the Stray Cats on Kowakujō.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Kowakujō: Cursed Mode, New Pack-a-Punch Camos[/p][p]Cursed mode on Kowakujō offers no Main Quest guidance and provides a limited HUD and only a starting Pistol. Hunt down new Cursed Relics and earn rewards including the following:[/p][list][*][p]The “Flame Cipher” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 15,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Toxic Cipher” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 20,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Blood Cipher” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 25,000 XP.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]New GobbleGum: Hellping Hound[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c0271d532751e65a57156ecaeb16e679b2f8ce13.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Bring the fire to your side with the new Hellping Hound Legendary GobbleGum. When the horde gets thick, this relentless canine is the perfect companion to thin out their ranks.[/p][p][/p][p]Zombies: Summon a friendly Hellhound to be your best friend. Lasts 5 minutes.[/p][p][/p][p]Dead Ops Arcade: Summons three Hellhounds to do your bidding. They will last a round or until they die.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Ultra-Rarity Mystery Box Weapon[/h3][p][/p][p]Face the burning horrors of Kowakujō with a new Ultra-Rarity Legacy Weapon arriving in the Mystery Box! Wield the infamous PPSh-41 SMG, ported over to Black Ops 7 with stats rivaling that of a Wonder Weapon including full Pack-a-Punch progression and Ammo Mod capabilities. Unleash hell on enemies with the weapon’s signature large magazine and rapid fire rate, perfect for keeping the heat at bay in the lava fields of Kowakujō.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Content[/u] [/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Rebirth Island Heats Up:[/b] With the arrival of summer, brighter weather returns to Rebirth Island. While the winter elements are removed, POIs like Turbine introduced in Season 02 will remain, albeit in a sunnier setting.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Limited-Time Modes:[/b] Gun Game goes bigger than ever with the arrival of Squad Gun Game, challenging squads of three to be the first to cycle through every weapon across Resurgence maps. Later in the season, Buy Back Quads returns as a Weekend LTM.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Take on the Champion’s Quest:[/b] The Champion’s Quest returns! For elite squads only, this is the ultimate test of ability. First, you must qualify, followed by a difficult multi-step mission culminating in an explosive ending that finishes the match and secures your standing alongside the best of the best.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]A New Season in Rebirth Island[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/86fcc8896c6f9e9f594c25e83ed3c13bc56fb6dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As summer arrives, the snow retreats across Rebirth Island, returning the notorious site to a lusher setting. The island will retain the features introduced in the Season 02 winter update, however, including the Turbine POI located due north of the Prison as well as the Outpost east of Stronghold and other minor changes across the map.[/p][p][/p][h3]New and Returning Modes[/h3][p][/p][p]Squad Gun Game[/p][p][i]Resurgence Maps, 30 Players[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/987ddf428dca942b9e0a9c110b84e423787b789c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Play Gun Game on an epic scale in Squad Gun Game, dropping ten squads of three across a rotating playlist of Rebirth Island, Haven’s Hollow, and Fortune’s Keep. For every elimination earned, your squad earns one point. Acquire five eliminations to advance to the next weapon tier. The first squad to cycle through all ten weapons wins the match.[/p][p][/p][p]Ammo reserves and armor plates are unlimited, so let loose on foes with no looting. When an Operator is eliminated, the location of their remaining squad members is pinged, encouraging aggressive play to chain eliminations. Downed players respawn after ten seconds, so there’s always room to claw your way back up to the top. To keep the action tense, the gas circle periodically shifts throughout the match, not shrinking but adjusting the field of battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep up the fight, adapt to each new weapon, and don’t stop until you’ve reached the end, cinching that all important victory.[/p][p][/p][p]Buy Back Quads[/p][p][i]Battle Royale Maps, 152 Players[/i][/p][p]From July 9 through 13, load up Call of Duty: Warzone to jump into the Buy Back Quads Weekend LTM. To help stay in the running, acquire as much cash as you can in the match; eliminated Operators who carry at least $4,000 in reserve will automatically redeploy, giving your squad the chance to regain and take the lead.[/p][p][/p][h3]Return of the Champion’s Quest[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/401747d176210cca7672dc48e26ee19f18937ef9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Best of the best, you say? Now’s your chance to prove it with the imminent return of the Champion’s Quest. Before you can even attempt it, you first need to gain access either by winning five consecutive Core Battle Royale matches or winning 30 matches in total across a single season.[/p][p][/p][p]Upon completing either prerequisite, acquire the Champion’s Contract by securing a designated briefcase in the match thus activating the quest. Once activated, the participating squad must embark on a brand new, challenging multi-step mission: [/p][p][/p][p]The CQ squad must complete a chain of objectives that will take them across the map, securing critical assets and delivering them to randomized designated locations. Along the way, squads will be tasked with transporting a hazardous radioactive isotope, recovering a valuable hard drive, and escorting a missile transport vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p]As the quest progresses, enemy teams will have opportunities to contest objectives, intercept carriers, and disrupt progress. A new “Golden Ticket” system also allows rival squads to extract stolen quest items and earn progress toward a Champion’s Quest token.[/p][p][/p][p]Combined with randomized locations, multiple opportunities for interference, and server-wide public events, the new Champion's Quest system turns into a match-wide event that's going to put even the most elite players to the test.[/p][p][/p][p]Pass the grueling test to unlock a unique Weapon Camo and a Legendary Animated Operator Skin for Grimm, proving to enemies just how lethal you really are.[/p][p][/p][p]For the most elite squads, try your hand at completing additional Champion’s Quests for even more rewards, including the following:[/p][list][*][p]1 Champion’s Quest (CQ) Win: “Containment Crew — Alpha” Weapon Camo, “Axia” Grimm Animated Operator Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]2 CQ Wins: “Darkly Dreaming” Animated Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3 CQ Wins: “Nuke Core” Animated Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]4 CQ Wins: “Death Filter” Spray[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]5 CQ Wins: “Containment Crew — Omega” Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]6 CQ Wins: “Gamma Stick” Flatline MK.II Melee Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]7 CQ Wins: “Critical Mess” Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]8 CQ Wins: “Axia’s Wrath — Alpha” Animated Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]9 CQ Wins: “Ion the Ball” Emote[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]10 CQ Wins: “Axia’s Wrath — Omega” Animated Weapon Camo[/p][/*][/list][p]And Other Rewards: There are other rewards to be earned, though what’s the fun in spoiling everything? For a start, Operators who defuse an armed nuke will be awarded an Animated Calling Card displaying their ability to thwart the enemy’s attempt at ending the match early.[/p][p][/p][p]Extract Elements: For those seeking another path toward unlocking the Champion’s Quest Contract, look out for a special Public Event that has a chance of activating within the match, alerting all Operators to an incoming element airdrop. The first player to interact with the dropped goods will initiate a special mission for their squad. Complete the steps before the match ends to earn a Champion's Quest Contract for the whole squad.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: General Content (END, MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Weapons, Attachments:[/b] Rush into battle, an axe in each hand, with the new Executioner’s Duet Melee Weapon. For ranged combat, the iconic AN-94 Assault Rifle returns with its signature quick burst firing mechanism. New Attachments include the XR-3 Ion Vulcan Minigun, DS20 Mirage Dual Fire Kit, and the Velox 5.7 Carbine Chassis.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events:[/b] This summer, Nick Cage leads the action in a brand-new Event Pass alongside the Summer of Action Daily Login Event, new Multiplayer and Resurgence Ranked Series Events, and the Kowakujō Event, bringing new rewards including Loadout items, Weapon Camos, Double XP Tokens, in-game cosmetics, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Free Trial:[/b] For a limited time, play Multiplayer and Zombies in Black Ops 7 for free![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Store Offerings:[/b] Look forward to a variety of new Bundles delivering premium content including Ultra Skins, Reactive content, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints, including the Tracer Pack: Ironclad Mastercraft Bundle featuring the “Chronovox” Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint for the new Season 04 Reloaded AN-94 Assault Rifle.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p][/p][p]Melee Weapon: Executioner’s Duet[/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e72f7484b44a45174fe50a9bcf66cc53fcbc7a22.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels: [/b]30[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] None[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints[/p][p][/p][p][i]Melee weapon. High damage, short range, and fast attack speed.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Hack and slash foes with the dual wield Executioner’s Duet. With an axe in each hand, be capable of unleashing a variety of slashing attacks designed to chop foes down to size. While the deadly weapon exhibits the shortest attack range of the current Melee Weapons on offer, it makes up for it with the highest mobility rating. Close the distance and start swinging.[/p][p][/p][p]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > Executioner’s Duet[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/49d38c72b0da963850724bdbdea353da8456dc17.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the Executioner’s Duet (above): Prestige 1: “Labyrinth.” Prestige 2: “Pop.” Prestige Max: “Radiance.”[/p][p][/p][p]Primary Weapon: AN-94[/p][p][i]Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb1934f696ca23dde2d5838b77fefed886d6e9c0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 42[/p][p][b]MAGS:[/b] 3[/p][p][b]MAG SIZE:[/b] 30[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camo Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][/p][p][i]Full-auto assault rifle. First two rounds fire at a faster rate. Slower handling and mobility.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The AN-94 makes its triumphant return. Last seen in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, the Assault Rifle features a unique burst mechanism where the first two shots fire at a faster rate before settling into a more moderate fire rate. [/p][p][/p][p]Connecting the first two shots is vital to quickly downing foes, and with burst fire you can benefit from the rapid double tap in fast succession. Luckily, the weapon’s clean iron sights make it easy to acquire targets even without an Optic equipped. Whether downing enemy players, Guild and Fear targets in Endgame, or the undead horde, the AN-94 is a reliable armament capable of performing in a wide variety of combat scenarios.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Prestige Attachment[/i][/b][/p][p][i]Barrel >  15" MFS Triumvirate Barrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/725120da90f9b80771466bbed94525a4669b19ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Modified barrel that increases hyperburst shot count to three and increases damage to the upper body. Adds a short delay after between hyperburst and full-auto fire and increases recoil.[/p][p][/p][p]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > AN-94[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d740f2c7eedc74142153a7ec3fa3c05e65442d5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the AN-94 (above): Prestige 1: “Splat.” Prestige 2: “Prism.” Prestige Max: “Abducted.”[/p][p][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments [/h3][p][/p][p]XR-3 Ion Vulcan Minigun (In-Season)[/p][p][i]XR-3 Ion Sniper Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Underbarrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2abfbf5ed80e9b6044f84b0b77f57368c0104d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Maximize control with this side-mounted foregrip that provides a focused hip fire with reduced spread and improved aiming movement speed. Blocks Optic Attachments.[/p][p][/p][p]DS20 Mirage Dual Fire Kit (In-Season)[/p][p][i]DS20 Mirage Assault Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Underbarrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9bb2f810b40e192d5ce63b535da8c4892ca60bf2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Replaces ADS with high-powered slug rounds. Greatly improves hipfire accuracy, at a small cost to mobility. Blocks Optic Attachments.[/p][p][/p][p]Velox 5.7 Carbine Chassis (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Velox 5.7 Pistol, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Barrel[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/642e99ce0018d7f344c6c9fa2b4cad1ed51ee657.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pistol chassis that converts the Velox 5.7 to full-auto and gives improved range capabilities, at the expense of baseline handling. Unlocks underbarrel and stock customization options.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 04 Reloaded Events[/h3][p][/p][p]Season 04 Reloaded delivers new challenges and rewards across multiple exciting events including an Event Pass starring Nick Cage. Progress through them all to gain access to new content including the AN-94 Assault Rifle, Executioner’s Duet Melee Weapon, Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Event: Nick Cage Event Pass (END, MP, ZM, WZ)[/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Nick Cage New Operator, Executioner’s Duet Melee Weapon, AN-94 Assault Rifle[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d38b351ccb673b21d583c187fa71d51a3729969e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Nick Cage brings the heat this summer in an action-packed Event Pass. newsitems.author: COMPLEX
newsitems.contents:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/9f1d1c4b0485c1e7b3b667d4a7c748bd55c5bb46.png[/img]
Following one of the most unforgettable days in Major playoff history, Saturday's Semifinals left two teams standing in pursuit of a Major Championship.

After losing the opening map of their Playoffs, FURIA have been unbeaten, rallying back against 9z Team to win 2-1 in the Quarterfinals and taking down Aurora Gaming 2-0 in the Semifinals to reach the Grand Finals for the first time in the organization's history. 

Team Falcons took down the world's #1 team, Team Vitality, 2-1 in the Quarterfinals. A day later, they punched their ticket to the Grand Finals by defeating Team Spirit 2-1 in dramatic fashion, needing Overtime in the third map. This is Team Falcons first Major Championship appearance.  

Coverage of the best of five Grand Finals between FURIA and Team Falcons begins with the opening ceremony at 16:45 CEST (10:45AM EDT). Don't miss a moment!

And with the Major coming to a close, team and player stickers are still available, with 50% of tournament item sales being shared with the tournament organizer, teams, and players.

Good luck to both teams!

newsitems.title: Valve calls out Dota 2 dataminers desperate for Dark Carnival news: "Why are you guys reading our variable names?"
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Rumors of a new Dota 2 event called Dark Carnival have been swirling among the MOBA's community for several months, with the leading speculation being that Valve is preparing a new, large-scale feature in the vein of 2024's Crownfall. Lately, in-game signs have suggested that something, at least, is on the horizon, and now eager dataminers have dug out a fresh line in the game's code that doubles down on that promise. In response, Valve has promptly changed the wording, turning it into a direct call-out message instead.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Valve calls out Dota 2 dataminers desperate for Dark Carnival news: "Why are you guys reading our variable names?"

Playoffs at the IEM Cologne 2026 Major begin tomorrow and the "Cathedral of Counter-Strike" awaits.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/c9131e2a48d99e4396581c0faa68467307e993c3.png[/img]

For the second consecutive Major, FURIA and Team Spirit finished Stage III with perfect 3-0 records. Aurora, Falcons, and Vitality finished 3-1, and 9z Team, BetBoom, and G2 Esports advanced with 3-2 records.

The Lanxess Arena will host the Playoffs, beginning with Thursday's Quarterfinals matchups:
[list]
[*] 9z Team vs. FURIA
[*] Aurora vs. BetBoom
[/list]The second set of Quarterfinals takes place Friday, featuring:
[list]
[*] G2 Esports vs. Team Spirit
[*] Falcons vs. Vitality
[/list]
With Semifinals on Saturday and the Grand Finals on Sunday, we're in for a great weekend of Counter-Strike.

As the Playoffs approach, there's still time to support your favorite teams. Team and player stickers are still available, with 50% of tournament item sales being shared with the tournament organizer, teams, and players.

And don't forget, all Playoff picks for the Pick'Em Challenge must be submitted prior to the first Playoff match beginning; you don't want to miss your Diamond Coin!

Vitality are looking to win their third straight Major. Will anyone stop them? Tune in and find out!

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/88c8fabaedf1c35cec50fafbf05ba805943df2da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is Warfare Without Limits. Experience the gripping story of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] first with our Campaign Early Access. Here’s how:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How Do I Access Modern Warfare Campaign Early Access?[/h2][p align="start"][i]Pre-Order, Play Early[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc1fde9de49a69f09bcbf9fcce54458ed264a7dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Campaign Early Access is confirmed![/p][p align="start"]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h2]No Line Holds Forever[/h2][p align="start"]In the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, you fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. What begins as a routine mission descends into chaos when North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, forcing Park and his unit into a desperate battle through collapsing cities and counteroffensives.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served. A hunt for revenge draws Price toward a weapon powerful enough to shift the balance of power, setting in motion a conflict far greater than he ever anticipated. Forced into uneasy alliances and off-book operations, Price is pulled deeper into consequences he can no longer escape.[/p][p align="start"]From large-scale battles and covert missions to combined-arms warfare and cinematic set pieces, the campaign delivers grounded combat and gameplay variety across a war that spreads far beyond the front lines.[/p][p align="start"] [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"][u]Click here for more information.[/u][/url][/p][p align="start"][i](*Actual platform availability and start date subject to change.)[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Stay Frosty.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8597bdedbfc8737241f64fe4bbcbcaf7eccb8bae.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Pre-orders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"][u]see the Preorder blog here[/u][/url].[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Infinity Ward, in partnership with Digital Legends, is developing [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] natively for Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual play time subject to possible outages and applicable time zone differences. newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ: Explore the Hajin Exclusion Zone
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a2c6a6d871e593d678a2da9f416c05df5d961a7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]DMZ // Overview[/h2][p align="start"][i]A High-Stakes, Action-Packed Extraction Shooter[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]DMZ is [i]Call of Duty[/i]’s definitive extraction shooter, a living world with unpredictable enemy encounters, weather, and objectives all brought together by meaningful match-to-match progression and inventory systems. Whether you plan to infil solo or with a squad, this volatile conflict zone offers numerous paths to choose from.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbb2b156cfa462836f7fdda8d2f28f9e511eefe5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]After experimenting and getting player feedback from the original DMZ Beta, [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]evolves the extraction shooter into a deeper, more cohesive, and more persistent combat experience shaped by what resonated most with players. Set in the Hajin exclusion zone and tied directly to the events of the Campaign, players deploy into a volatile Exclusion Zone, choosing how to survive, whether pushing deeper into dangerous territory for greater rewards, hunting high-value targets, defending against escalating enemy threats, completing story missions, or extracting before the situation becomes untenable.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // Setting[/h2][p align="start"][i]Into the Exclusion Zone[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]SUMMARY: Enter a contested exclusion zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with securing advanced military technology before it falls into hostile hands. [/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ca7111264241a5f195dfac25dfddd1dfd52bba2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Following the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign, an exclusion zone across the Korean peninsula remains saturated with abandoned military technology, weapons stockpiles, and destabilizing threats. Operating as a shadow CIA asset, you are deployed behind enemy lines and tasked with securing the various weapons and technology left behind before they fall into enemy hands. Both Rogue Operators and enemy combatants are active throughout the zone, forcing every squad to decide when to cooperate, when to engage, and when to disappear before tensions escalate.[/p][p align="start"]Loot, fight, negotiate, betray, and extract whatever you can carry.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Setting // Hajin: The New Frontline[/h3][p align="start"][i]A Region Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Hajin is a dense exclusion zone built around exploration, discovery, and high-risk player-driven operations, where environmental storytelling and hidden discoveries reward players willing to push deeper into the unknown.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11401a19332b87c5d97b958236390e79aab4789f.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Nestled within a tri-point region bordering Russia and the Korean peninsula, Hajin is a contested exclusion zone where rival forces battle for control of abandoned military technology and strategic assets left behind after the events of the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign.[/p][p align="start"]The atmosphere within the Hajin Exclusion Zone shifts can change based environmental effects, creating new opportunities and challenges on every run. Sudden downpours can reduce visibility and force Operators to adapt how they explore, move and engage, while dense fog banks and overcast skies transform familiar routes into tense navigational gambles.[/p][p align="start"]Scarred by radiation, mass evacuation, and the collapse of civilian infrastructure, the region is one of the largest and most ambitious Call[i] of Duty[/i] environments ever built, designed around exploration, environmental storytelling, and high-risk operations. From the irradiated Fallout reactor and the highly secured Prison complex to the remains of Hajin City and the heavily defended Military Base, every region inside the border area and exclusion zone offers different combat opportunities, sealed or hidden areas waiting to be discovered, traversal challenges and points of interest with hidden entrances accessible only via water, and other operational risks. Players willing to push deeper into the unknown can uncover hidden secrets, pursue high-value gear, and engage in increasingly dangerous missions with greater risks and rewards.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // Operations // Story Missions[/h2][p align="start"][i]Operations Pushing the Narrative Forward[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Continue the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] story through narrative-driven Story Missions built for replayability, squad-based action, and evolving storytelling throughout live seasons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98fbd9003e450d9b54f78a0d7efec3004cc0aae1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]A collection of Story Missions expands the narrative of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], and features unique objectives, high-stakes action, and gameplay scenarios unfolding inside specific points of interest across Hajin, all within a live DMZ server populated by other operators pursuing their own missions. Built for squads and solo players with replayability in mind, Story Missions push the broader DMZ narrative forward through new discoveries and fresh challenges over time.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Operations // Dynamic Operations, Side Ops and Free Roam[/h3][p align="start"][i]Activities that Evolve Every Match[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take on guided Operations featuring evolving scenarios, escalating threats, and climactic moments unique to every match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eec6fc961d0f785244bbf3563e3632c0a8479112.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before deployment, your objectives in DMZ are clearly defined: a focus on Story Missions, engaging in Dynamic Operations, and free explorations across Hajin. But no plan is guaranteed to last. The unpredictable nature of DMZ often demands quick adjustments as situations evolve in the field. Whether you decide to stay covert or bring the fight directly to your enemies, every match is an opportunity to push deeper into Hajin, uncover valuable intel and hidden secrets, and hunt down rogue enemy Operators to build your infamy.[/p][p align="start"]Dynamic Operations are multi-step objectives generated for each match and designed to create focused tasks, from neutralizing abandoned weapons programs and securing critical assets to high-risk rescue operations and assaults against hostile forces. Every Operation in this extraction shooter is built around escalating tension, replayability, and large-scale moments capable of impacting activity across the wider region.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76d2a11d899832f1eae3078145264a0186f7ace1.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Even a seemingly routine task can lead to intriguing exploration: Side Ops are available and include activities like locating trucks across Hajin that have advantageous functionality once they’re repaired, locating lost supply drops, or scaling damaged radio towers. There’s the freedom to explore like never before, even into sectors of extreme danger like the area of heavy fallout in the eastern part of the map, where it takes a gas mask and gumption to find loot only available in this point of interest.[/p][p align="start"]Beyond these Operations, Hajin supports free-roaming exploration for players who want to forge their own path, preserving the open-ended freedom that defines the DMZ experience. Whether hunting rival Operators, scavenging for resources, hunting down dangerous Lieutenants, accessing phones to initiate Dynamic Operations, commandeering a derelict casino while attempting to break into the vault without attracting a rival squad’s attention, or simply surviving long enough to extract, these side tasks add unpredictability and player choice.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]DMZ // A Living World[/h2][p align="start"][i]Low and Slow or Fast and Loud[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Rival factions, roaming patrols, and shifting world events ensure that no two operations unfold the same way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d132c5d789778a8e64513eff003cf3c722eca6c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Players decide how to approach Hajin — moving low and slow through hostile territory, risking everything with an aggressive assault, or something in-between — while dynamic world systems respond to every action. Vehicle convoys move across the roadways, air traffic fills the skies, and hostile forces constantly reposition WMDs and strategic assets. With enemy factions and rival human squads battling for control of key locations, every operation can evolve in unexpected ways. Hajin represents an extreme opportunity for exploration.[/p][p align="start"]DMZ also benefits from the advancements in movement and combat systems introduced in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], including enhanced traversal options like climbing pipes and navigating environmental obstacles with fluidity, alongside refined weapon handling, ballistic authority, and other mechanics that carry across the broader game experience.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Emergent Enemies[/h3][p align="start"][i]Advances in Enemy Combat Intelligence[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Improved AI combatants allow for larger combat spaces with coordinated enemy squads, reactive combat behaviors, and more dynamic infantry and vehicle encounters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f4cd320b29df6c1234c37dcfb53e1ac15eec0d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]brings a new level combat density beyond anything seen in Call of Duty before. Hostiles throughout the exclusion zone are guarding key areas, traveling in convoys, flying in choppers and moving in large squads.  New squad generation systems help AI adversaries move beyond individual enemy behavior, with units that coordinate, navigate, react, and pressure players more convincingly. Approach lone AI enemies, and expect them to take cover and hold position, freeze, or try to break your line of sight. Combined with advances in game engine physics and squad/vehicle interactions, these systems make combat feel more active and unpredictable, opening the door to new forms of emergent gameplay.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ // A Living World // Escalating Threats[/h3][p align="start"][i]Push the World, and it Pushes Back[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Escalating threat levels trigger stronger enemy responses, increasingly dangerous reinforcements, and elite forces sent to hunt players down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/845feceac2caaf5138d7c73b6d5c77705daadd3c.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Hostile threats across Hajin range from ruthless Lieutenants leading specialized units to roaming commander enemies that include tanks, drone swarms, Deathstalker helicopters, Juggernauts, and Elite Strike Teams. The DMZ threat system tracks player activity and escalates enemy responses as operators attract increasing attention inside the region. As threat levels rise, enemy forces mobilize to reassert control, deploying increasingly dangerous reinforcements to hunt players down. These forces include attack helicopters, more dangerous and heavily armored troops and eventually enemy Deathstalkers being dispatched to chase you down.[/p][p align="start"]Survival depends on more than firepower alone; success comes from strategy, adaptability, and controlling the pace of combat before the engagement spirals out of control. One of these ways is using the Stealth Meter, a system that assists Solo players particularly well, as it helps you control combat when facing AI enemies. If you’re close to being spotted by AI adversaries, expect an audio cue and an indicator on your HUD that changes from white to yellow to orange. Hit the deck or get back into cover to prevent the observing hostile from being alerted.  [/p][h3] [/h3][h3]DMZ // Progression // FOB[/h3][p align="start"][i]Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: A hub between operations, your FOB can be upgraded to unlock new services, expand operational capabilities, and prepare your squad for future deployments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20863df32fe99346cc6cc8892005973123ed3cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Before and after every extraction operation inside the DMZ, players return to their Forward Operating Base (FOB), a central hub built around preparation, progression, and long-term squad support. The FOB gives players access to key operational services including the 3D Printer crafting station, The Stash where inventory items can be stored deployment to deployment, weapon purchasing, a firing range, bounty boards, and additional upgrade systems that unlock over time. It also serves as a staging ground and social hub where squad members can regroup, rearm, inspect their Operators, assist with onboarding newer players, and prepare before deployment. As players earn XP, complete Missions, progress through the Trait System, gaining the reputation and skillset of an elite Tier 1 operator over time, the Forward Operating Base evolves alongside you, unlocking new functionality while visually transforming to better support your growing capabilities.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]A Tour of Your Forward Operating Base[/i][/p][p align="start"]The FOB is the operational backbone of DMZ. Access the following via the physical FOB spaces and streamlined menu navigation. Note that imagery of the FOB will be unveiled at a later date.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Orders and Objectives:[/b] Track your active Missions, review completed objectives, check available completion rewards, and plan future operations before heading back into the field.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stash and Loadout:[/b] Between deployments, players can manage a persistent inventory containing weapons, equipment, consumables, valuables, and special items. Gear can be organized between your Stash, and your Active Duty Operator's Backpack and Loadout. Each Active Duty Operator has their own Backpack and Loadout. The Stash size can also be upgraded by ranking up in DMZ. Operators looking to infil immediately can choose a Free Loadout containing combat essentials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wallet: [/b]Use in-game cash primarily to purchase weapons and Gunsmithing attachments, as well as rescuing MIA operators, paying for Lieutenant Intel and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing Missions and Ops is the primary source of cash, wired directly to the Wallet in the FOB. Expenditure of funds is a key consideration in DMZ, and players may wish to employ an Active Duty Operator as a cash mule with particular skills when breaking into vaults, defeating HVTs (or other Bounty-tagged human prey) or completing Dynamic Ops to earn cash.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D Printer:[/b] Gather resources throughout Hajin and return them to the FOB’s crafting station: As a general rule, the 3D Printer is capable of manufacturing a vast array of functional equipment and support gear (with a detailed list later in this blog), excluding Primary, Secondary, and Melee weaponry. Recipes unlock the ability to use component resources to craft a wide variety of Gear; items like night vision goggles, ballistic vests, backpacks, consumables, Killstreaks, and other specialized Equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunsmith: [/b]Weapons and related attachments are purchased using Cash in Gunsmith. The more effective the weapon or attachment the more expensive they are. As you progress through Mission Orders and extract Weapon Manuals from Hajin, the option of purchasing the weapons directly becomes available, but initially you'll have to rely on weapons scavenged during deployments. You can use cash to modify weapons with attachments you've unlocked, including Apex Attachments, but each one has a cost: suppressors, extended mags, powerful optics, and more all cost extra for the added effectiveness.[/p][list][*][p]The Gunsmith allows you to add up to five Attachments to a weapon, along with an Apex Attachment. However, eight-Attachment weapons have been confirmed within Hajin.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Progression tracks across Multiplayer and DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Vendor: [/b]DMZ Operators with enough in-game cash can purchase additional specialized weaponry from the FOB’s military supplier. These weapons are added directly to your Stash. The selection is limited and rotating, refreshing after a period of real-time has occurred. If you’re after a professionally built armament and don’t have the time to extract or purchase a gun and modify it, or use the Gunsmith, then this is an excellent option. Weapon Vendor firearms can be adjusted just like scavenged or purchased weapons, and don’t negatively affect your looting or progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Range (First Person):[/b] Located adjacent to the Gunsmith and Vendor, the firing range allows Operators to test Primary and Secondary weapon builds in a dedicated first-person training environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Active Duty (Operators):[/b] Manage your available Operators, including those awaiting recovery after failed exfils. Each Operator maintains their own persistent Backpack, persistent Loadout, and persistent Trait Tree. This mission readiness allows players to prepare specialized kits for different deployment styles. Operator Traits (see below) can also be managed here.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Board:[/b] Review the latest intel on hostile Lieutenants (LTs); high-ranking enemy targets operating throughout Hajin before you drop into a match and attempt to neutralize these targets. Here, you can pay for intel related to a particular Lieutenant that allows you to pinpoint their location more accurately and reach them before your rivals do. Or climb Hunt Towers across Hajin, accessing a terminal to receive intel on the closest Lieutenant to your location. Slay a Lieutenant, and they drop a set of Dog Tags.[/p][list][*][p][b]Lieutenant’s Dog Tags: [/b]Exfilling with these spoils of combat helps populate your Boss Board and are helpful to your continued success as an LT killer. However, they are equally valuable to enemy squads, who can track you via any Lieutenant’s Dog Tags you’ve acquired during a match. Expect fierce resistance from rival teams attempting to appropriate your LT’s Dog Tags, usually at hot exfil points, so they can populate their own Boss Board.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bounty Leaderboard: [/b]Monitor the most dangerous rival players currently operating inside the Exclusion Zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deploy:[/b] Before deploying into Dynamic Operations or Free Roam your squad can choose how to infil with the Paid Infil System. Go in quiet on foot, or fast and loud in a helicopter or large plane. Do you have the need for a vehicle dropped with you? The game has got you covered.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]DMZ // Progression // Active Duty Operators[/h2][p align="start"][i]Build Your Specialized Squad[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recruit and customize a roster of specialized Operators while earning progression through every operation inside the DMZ.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bea52286d5ea8d1fd5e2c71d4cf5a9a404011766.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]DMZ features a dedicated progression system built around a persistent inventory and long-term Operator growth. Within the FOB’s “Active Duty” menu, players can create multiple Operators as the Active Duty slot system returns from DMZ Beta, with each Operator owning a backpack and loadout persistent through multiple deployments, and customize them through the Trait System, assembling a roster of professional recruits suited for different mission types and playstyles. The more players accomplish during an operation, the more XP and progression rewards they earn, encouraging more risk-taking and deeper exploration. These multiple layers of progression provide a deep and rewarding experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]Global Player and DMZ XP: [/b]Story Missions, Dynamic Operators, and Side Ops are all excellent methods of obtaining XP, along with additional activities and enemy takedowns.[b] [/b]This is irrespective of whether you successfully exfilled or not; there are no XP penalties for dying during a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DMZ XP:[/b] All XP earned in DMZ upgrades your FOB, unlocks new Stations in your FOB, and ranks up your Operator. This allows you to unlock game-changing Traits to customize your playstyle..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]The Trait Operator Progression System[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Within the Active Duty station of the FOB, players can spend earned Trait Points on individual Operators to improve their effectiveness across a variety of disciplines, utilizing them from a roster of persistent characters. Earn Trait Points during missions and invest them into one of three Trait Trees, each leaning into a different skillset related to combat, scavenging, and other capabilities. Points are tied to the Operator who earned them. Unlock Traits along with passive benefits that allow you the freedom to specialize individual Operators for specific roles, including proficiency in PvP engagements, infiltration, looting, recoveries, or as a cash mule.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Looting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Supplies Where They Should Be[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Search for weapons, equipment, and crafting materials placed naturally throughout the region based on location and strategic value.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42f0a23fc40e779805097849b97c8ed96c16fafa.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Looting is a core part of progression in DMZ, built around meaningful resource gathering that rewards players who learn the region, study the map, and understand where valuable resources might be found. Finding unique ingredients in Hajin becomes a major focus, especially as you learn recipes – combinations of ingredients allowing the creation of better gear. Hunting for rarer ingredients that build more powerful equipment like printing Killstreaks, improved Plate Carriers, or Backpack types, and searching for recipes that upgrade your 3D printer to enable you to print even more potent items, results in a much more meaningful looting experience.[/p][p align="start"]Supplies and loot are primarily distributed in ways that feel grounded and logical within the world itself, encouraging smart exploration and decision-making. Police stations contain combat gear and tactical equipment. Hospitals may have scarce medical supplies. Residential districts offer valuable crafting resources and scavenged materials. Designed to minimize inventory friction and keep players focused on the action, the looting system emphasizes player agency, preparation, and risk-versus-reward.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Crafting[/h3][p align="start"][i]Build the Gear You Need[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Gather resources throughout Hajin and use the upgraded 3D Printer system to craft equipment, weapons, and high-end gear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eba9d776f3200d19c586f4fd9f931b0a5bba8db7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Crafting gives players greater control over how they prepare for future operations by transforming recovered resources into valuable equipment and combat-ready tools. Materials are disassembled automatically during a mission so players can stay focused on the action, while inventory management is easy to navigate. Extracted loot can be used back at your FOB within an intuitive crafting system built around a powerful upgradable 3D Printer capable of unlocking increasingly advanced crafting options, allowing players to manufacture equipment and rare gear.[/p][p align="start"]The categories of Gear you can 3D print are as follows:[/p][p align="start"]Here are the categories of Gear:[/p][list][*][p][b]Gear:[/b] Tactical equipment such as NVGs and Parachutes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Backpacks:[/b] Packs of varying sizes and specializations carried into a match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plate Carriers:[/b] Craft different types of armor vests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tacticals:[/b] Stock up on strategic, non-lethal equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lethals:[/b] Assemble offensive equipment designed to damage or eliminate threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumables:[/b] Beneficial items, from pain killers to radiation blockers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Field Upgrades:[/b] Abilities providing tactical support or intelligence. Unlike Multiplayer, Field Upgrades in DMZ do not recharge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Support Items:[/b] Deployable offensive killstreak support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tracked Recipes:[/b] A series of tagged recipes you’re on the hunt for.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Items:[/b] A wide variety of items used for a wide variety of purposes.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The deeper players push into the region, the more opportunities they uncover to secure rarer resources needed to support stronger loadouts and specialized playstyles.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Weapon Condition and Variants[/h3][p align="start"][i]Equipment Shaped by Conflict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Recover damaged weapons and rarer enemy variants shaped by the harsh realities of the exclusion zone.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]After combat, players can scavenge for dropped armaments, many with damaged optics, broken attachments, unstable weapon components, and improvised field repairs that affect both appearance and handling. High-value lieutenants also carry uniquely customized weapons featuring attachments and camouflage finishes.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]DMZ // Progression // Recovery Systems[/h3][p align="start"][i]Extract. Or Die Trying[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Failed extractions carry real consequences, but recovery systems ensure players can continue progressing and return to the fight.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d4e0aeafeb799c3c028b1039746efb22ca1a8ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Though squads have multiple options to exfil from Hajin from helicopters to skyhooks, not every deployment ends in success. When an Operator is downed, they may be rescued, left to fend for themselves, or become lost in action. Fortunately, there are additional options:[/p][p align="start"][b]Tourniquet: [/b]A new survival mechanic is the Tourniquet, allowing you to heal to a wounded state if you don’t have self-revive equipped. You won’t last long after a Tourniquet application, so you’ll need to apply additional medical items to reach full health.[/p][p align="start"][b]MIA System: [/b]For those lost in action, the new MIA system allows players to expend in-game cash at the FOB and deploy rescue teams to recover them and continue their progression without starting from scratch. DMZ is designed to preserve the tension and high-stakes risk that define extraction shooter gameplay while remaining a little more forgiving than traditional extraction experiences. Every infil is still a gamble, with valuable rewards, equipment, and resources on the line until you successfully extract. While failed operations carry meaningful setbacks, players continue earning XP, unlocking rewards and traits, and advancing long-term progression. Every deployment moves you forward, but greater success still demands skill and tactical judgment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]DMZ // PvP[/h2][p align="start"][i]Hunter or Hunter Killer[/i][/p][p][/p][p]SUMMARY: Take down rival Operators, build notoriety, and climb the Bounty leaderboard as the hunt escalates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/285149140ea1bac657ce5d14eaf7419252ad5307.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The hostile forces occupying Hajin are dangerous enough, but they’re not the only threat in the Exclusion Zone. Other squads or solo players are also deploying into Hajin, adding an unpredictable human element to every operation as players compete for valuable objectives and extraction opportunities. Every encounter carries uncertainty, forcing squads to decide whether to engage. For players who thrive on competition, DMZ’s Bounty system turns every engagement with rival Operators into a risk-versus-reward decision. Hunting other players raises your notoriety and puts a price on your head, making you more visible and easier to track. As a player’s notoriety grows, successful hunters can become some of the most dangerous targets inside Hajin. Earn a place on the infamous Bounty leaderboard by becoming a notorious killer or a bounty hunter. Secure rival dog tags and successfully extract for substantial payouts, along with serious bragging rights. Every Operator eliminated raises both the rewards and the dangers of operating inside Hajin, though hunting bounty targets can lessen the target on your own back.[/p][p align="start"][b]Proximity Chat: [/b]In these high-tension situations, where life and death hang in the balance, you’ll need to stay frosty and employ vocal communication to end an engagement either peacefully, or with a satisfactory kill. With an upgraded engine comes a revamped Proximity Chat, allowing you to listen to (or mute) rival Operators within the vicinity of you or your squad, along with the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Distance-Based Vocal Falloff:[/b] Expect to find it easier to hear rival enemies the closer they are to you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Directionality:[/b] Pinpoint chatter more precisely depending on the direction your foe is approaching from.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Voice Reverb:[/b] The type of interior structure or exterior topography affects the reverberations and echo of incoming comms, perhaps giving clues to their whereabouts.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]See You in Hajin[/h3][p align="start"]Built on the same foundation powering [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer — including refined and fluid movement across maps, an expanded equipment and full complement of weaponry, enhanced gunplay and Ballistic Authority — DMZ brings the full breadth of [i]Call of Duty[/i] combat into a persistent extraction experience.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Stay Frosty[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df5080a975ac203fe9a87234bfbcf869d42824d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p align="start"]For more information on DMZ, be sure to check out additional announcements at the XBOX Games Showcase, as well as the latest episode of the CODPOD, both on Sunday, June 7. Expect further DMZ intel arriving in the weeks and months ahead.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url]. For more information on preordering, including Vault Edition content, rewards, and a special Loyalty Discount, [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]see the Preorder blog here[/url][/u].[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p]

newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/554111/cdee279951600e2e94e58dc1ae778b87411de00a.png[/img]

After more than six months of stealth development, a super duper secret alpha, and a ton of broken sentry guns, TFCL is back and ready for public testing! TFCL is a North American competitive 6v6 league. Registration for TFCL's Alpha Season 2 opened on May 21st and runs through July 5th!
 
To make things even more awesome, they're throwing a $504 prize pool at this season! And medals, of course. Can't forget those!
 
Alpha Season 2 will last approximately 6 weeks, with an additional week or two for playoffs. There will be 12 matches, two per week, on servers located in North America. Entry is free. TFCL will host and configure all match servers, so all you have to do is sit back, compete, and have fun!
 
More information can be found [url=https://tfcleague.com/alpha2]here[/url]!
