newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2cfac2ca7800e91b1d42af7115e70f83bec622e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Yours for the Taking: Black Ops Season 04 is Here![/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]The Story So Far[/h3][p] [/p][p]After David Mason is captured by The Guild and Specter Two goes on the offense with their own man on the inside, Karma's Guild-killing virus is finally ready to deploy... but Dorne has one last card to play. A collision of forces at JSOC's secret jungle hideout will determine the shape of the future.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Roadmap[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f2ddd972b454b36a052faf67b8076914fbe6310.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], Season 04 introduces another massive season of content. Take on Operation Wall Breaker in Endgame, deploy across five new and remastered Multiplayer Maps, hail the return of Fortune’s Keep, fight off the horde in the new Rogue Run game mode set on Ashes of the Damned in Zombies, and much more![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="59AgHBmGozI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 04 is yours for the taking. Join the action in this substantial update packed with free and premium content arriving when [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Season 04 goes live on Thursday, June 4th at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Expanded Operations:[/b] At the start of the season, The Guild strikes back in Operation Wall Breaker, introducing new challenges and rewards alongside the deadly Command Killer Glitch Fracture. In the Mid-Season, keep up the fight in Operation King Killer.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operator Prestige: [/b]Achieve new milestones in Endgame with the introduction of Operator Prestige. Hit max Combat Rating and Prestige to unlock even more ways to build your playstyle, including an extra Exotic slot, extra Nightmare slot, and a fourth Skill Track![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, Two Abilities:[/b] Make mincemeat out of your foes with the addition of the Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, get access to the new Guardian Skill Track and send targets over the edge with the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Act III: Operation Wall Breaker (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5d75fe1f40689821b2b911b2de669999e716dc1.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]The Guild strikes back: a Command Node is preventing Karma’s virus from attacking their network. Scour Avalon for enough Mapping Data to locate the Node and take it down.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The push to infiltrate The Guild’s network has hit a snag, and unless Karma and her allies can find their way past the company firewall, their plans will have been in vain.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Season 04, players must return to Avalon to find the weak link in Guild security, starting with the search for the region’s hidden network hub. Find it, breach the firewall, and gain the permissions needed to successfully access the command center node.[/p][p] [/p][p]Once you’ve breached the command node, it’s time to crack The Guild’s operations wide open. Enter the ensuing Command Killer Glitch Fracture and complete the mission.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea98b1519aa15487ab3ba69b1b1bfd5a3cee8f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators who progress through the steps in Act III will earn a bounty of in-game rewards, all while empowering your Operator for the challenges ahead. In the final phase, locate the Command Killer Glitch Fracture to battle through relentless waves of enemies in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Command Killer Glitch Boss with 50/50, Razor, or Faulkner to earn their unique “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins.[/p][p] [/p][p]Act III Completion Rewards: [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skin to earn the “Decay” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins to access the “Visitors” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Operation Wall Breaker Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df0ca290cb02b4fc40ba0a784047b562201959d5.jpg"][/img] [/p][list][*][p]“Brain Freeze” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Splitter” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Frost Beast” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fractal Cry” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forehead Slap” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Cold Shoulder” Weapon Blueprint, “Terms of Service” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]More in the Mid-Season[/p][p] [/p][p]There’s no time to let up while The Guild is fighting this hard to maintain their dominance in Avalon. In the Mid-Season, get ready to take on Act IV: Operation King Killer, introducing new challenges and rewards. Get more intel when the Season 04 Reloaded blog arrives in the lead up to the Mid-Season.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Operator Prestige (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54bbdfc86f184154cbde5013871d0b6868e606c9.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Starting with Season 04, Endgame Operators with a maxed-out Combat Rating (CR) will gain the option to enter Operator Prestige 1, starting a whole new leveling journey in exchange for greater power. Entering Prestige discards all equipped Skills, resets the Operator’s CR, discards equipped Field Acquisitions, and resets Loadout weapons to their base rarity.[/p][p] [/p][p]From this fresh state, redeploy to Avalon and start upping your CR again. With each Prestige, your Operator will earn access to additional skillsets, including:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige 1: [/b]Extra Exotic Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 2: [/b]Extra Nightmare Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 3: [/b]Equip a 4th Skill Track[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Two New Abilities[/h3][p] [/p][p]At launch, unleash fury on your enemies as the devastating Death Machine joins the list of available Major Abilities. In the Mid-Season, keep your armor and ammo stocked with the new Guardian Skill Track and send foes into a psychotic spiral with the addition of the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Payback: [/b]Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Battle Cache: [/b]Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Power Tap: [/b]Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fortified: [/b]Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Iron Grip: [/b]Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse: [/b]If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Major Ability: Death Machine (Launch)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4e3524cc1797ee944ea5dac20ecfb501217e187.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Deadly machine gun. High damage per shot and large magazine capacity.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Endgame's free-to-play period will extend to the end of Season 05, so bring your friends and jump into all the new content waiting for you in Avalon! If you haven't tried Endgame yet, now's the perfect time to start earning all the Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and additional rewards the mode has to offer.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] At launch, descend into a Guild procedure where the patient’s unstable mind reshapes the map in Liminal, battle within a Japanese game show in Primetime, and watch your step on the remastered Vertigo. In the Mid-Season, play through a map of traps in the new Zenith and activate a rocket on the remastered Launch.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Wind back the clock with Black Ops Classic, wield sleek weapons in Blueprint Gun Game, and adapt to your given Loadout in 6v6 Gunfight. Later in the season, cycle through weapons in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter and ditch the ranged weapons in Knife Fight.   [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Loadout Content:[/b] Drop deadly munitions over their heads with the new Iron Rain Scorestreak, a high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft providing a bird’s-eye view of the battle. Upgrade it further with the Active Camo or Tactical Radar Overclocks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, featuring a completely overhauled transparent Skill Rating system where every point of SR earned and lost is clearly explained in the post-match summary.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b] [/p][p]Liminal (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e41adb763502e9e78dfb7299debb93b6ff9c5dda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Descend into a live Guild procedure mid-test, where the patient’s response to the experiment actively rewrites the center of the map. When the subject is calm, a red pillar stands intact on a raised platform; when agitation spikes, it fractures and slams into a crater, throwing up fresh cover and new angles around the impact zone.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/71d96c17491b305bf01c5c187bc695a53582f65f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]When the subject accepts the procedure, the space shifts into a “nature” state, with organic growth reclaiming the central structure and subtly reshaping lanes and sightlines. Corridors feed the core from both sides, cutting past elevators on one flank and offices on the other, keeping rotations tight and fights constant as the room changes under pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p]Primetime (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c9098082f493b559e2c1d8b78e40145a527b15a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let no obstacle stand in your way on Primetime, a new 6v6 Multiplayer map themed around a Japanese game show obstacle course. Battle over speed tracks, Wall Jump across bound pads, and rack up points on the board as Operators weave between supersized crates.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c2e31f1d5eb5e7db7f00cf9b9b7e1ab8328ba4f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Make a splash across the Pool track running over the water, a catapult on either end providing quick access to the middle. To get out of the limelight, head to the close-quarters Backstage or head further out along the southern Cargo path running parallel to the course.[/p][p] [/p][p]Vertigo (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e206044cb10042875fd611613237fffdf87bb8f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First introduced in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 2[/i], Vertigo returns fully remastered and ready for action in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. The map features a new Japanese setting, though the layout will be familiar to veterans of the original.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/745fab79d4f7c4a0bed609fef82180f7b9090ef8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Watch your balance as the wind whips by atop the massive skyscraper, newly refurbished as Guild property. A steep drop-off awaits careless Operators fighting along the outer perimeter amongst the Vents, Utility and Storage sheds, and alongside the Helipad. For sturdier ground, head to the inner walkway connected to the East and West Wing, which funnel players into a tight space with guardrails to keep you from plummeting to your demise. [/p][p] [/p][p]Zenith (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea3a92bed9280ae53acbe127d72cf1424f7f18a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Breach a luxurious cliffside abode in Zenith, a waterfall in the distance and pristine lighting guiding you through the immaculate grounds. Battle inside the building, marveling at the bleeding edge tech and expensive artwork, and check for details on the site intrusion in the Security room.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e782674c98bc0fab312df57614bedb98cac55e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a sneakier approach, traverse the running water below, accessible from the outside and from a secret entrance via the inner Office. Use the stairs and vine trellises located all over the area to gain some elevation.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/15edbe05b7eecd878ff0c3171f855476f6b09c85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for a variety of engagement types across the Keep; although the structure is large, its sheer number of corridors and rooms turn a long-distance fight into a short one in seconds. The POI extends to the Keep’s outer walls, so check every corner while approaching the sprawling compound, and use all available intel to track enemy movement within.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gatehouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f209d5c8770564a095ec02b6b388513155a9f9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Gatehouse is the entrance to the Keep’s primary grounds and sits directly in the center of the island. Surrounded by several other major POIs, it’s a difficult area to control, though the reward is worth the risk if you’re ready for constant engagements around it. Note the nearby sewer entrance for a concealed flanking path, and the Ascender giving access to the top of the Gatehouse battlements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Bay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06ed951dcec95910cb62bdc5a76c71dcfea2a198.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned along the eastern shore, the once peaceful Bay is home to beachfronts, cliffsides, and the new Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory. Use the Bay’s lowered elevation to keep out sight from the main roads, and as a reliable access point for watercraft with helipad right next to the boat launch. Don’t miss the cliff tunnels up the dirt path, providing a stealthy approach toward the Keep.[/p][p] [/p][p]Winery[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6b086196f1126fbb482d81ca551ea8c1f9db0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Taking up a significant portion of the island’s east end, the Winery is often contested, whether fighting within the center courtyard or sending out suppressive fire around its perimeter. Note that there are several points of access down into the basement below, a haven from the action above, though be prepared for close-quarters combat should an enemy follow you there.[/p][p] [/p][p]Pier[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d42973c10909b75c24ac4a11d031fbc346e28db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Like the Bay POI, the Pier offers a respite from the main action of the island, but that hardly makes it a light walk along the beach. Expect to encounter vehicles traversing the Pier as it is also near a major crossroad. Use the dotted beach terrain and scenery, as well as the cliffside, to escape from tough fights and get into a better position for the counterattack.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lighthouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba302c5def3483f85527864847384ffe544dab4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check for snipers when approaching the Lighthouse, an Ascender giving access to its upper platform with views over a significant portion of the surrounding area. The shoreline here is extremely dangerous, with little cover against attacks from above. Instead, consider exploring behind the Lighthouse when traversing the nearby grounds, full of cover points with a tunnel into the cliffside and zipline toward Smuggler’s Cove.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overlook[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb8248af12e1f8600098e0812c6980bf00a5284a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overlook provides a powerful vantage point over the Town and its surrounding areas. The section closest to Smuggler’s Cove features a high-end restaurant with a picturesque view of both the ocean and the eastern end of Fortune’s Keep, while farther up you’ll find a small village area including access to the tallest section of the cliff. Claiming this area offers great map control in the vicinity, so long as the gas hasn’t cleared the place out yet.[/p][p] [/p][p]Town[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7dfecc39f899bb1918d2db014126951a461b557.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators seeking close-quarters, urban combat should head into Town along the map’s western shore. A treasure trove a loot awaits within its tightly packed layout, so long as you’re prepared to engage enemies at a moment’s notice and often face to face. Its lower elevation makes the area susceptible to attacks from the outside, so be on the lookout for enemy forces when it’s time to exit the area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Graveyard[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4334c93ee1f02c780b11667ef4a1510b981c1562.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There’s little cover here, but the tombs and outer walls do provide some cover in a pinch. There’s a steep drop off to the shore here, so beware of enemy squads attempting a flanking attack from the west. Within the Graveyard, look for the easternmost sepulcher providing access to a belowground passageway. If you prefer a clear view, climb the stairs to the top of the nearby round tower.[/p][p] [/p][p]Grotto[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92e38e32438a9d449c29ba73c5561b02349b20cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get way below the action in the Grotto, positioned at the base of the cliffs with access to several cave systems leading to other parts of the map like the Lighthouse and the Graveyard. Getting to these cave systems requires landing safely and fighting any enemy squads within the Grotto or directly above on the surface.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler’s Cove[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db890d8a6b3c1a6fb46c27fc432c2bbb402fcd28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Secluded from the main island, Smuggler’s Cove upholds its reputation for stockpiling illegally sourced cargo within the deep-sea caves. The shallow waters somewhat limit mobility, so seek out an elevated position when possible. For a quick escape, back up into the cave systems of the nearby Grotto or use the area’s system of ladders, walkways, and Ascenders to reclaim the high ground.[/p][p] [/p][p]Research Vessel[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d38397073857dfac0db935621ac8621dba4bff4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This pontoon-style watercraft circles the shoreline of Fortune’s Keep in the opening minutes of the match before eventually dropping anchor. The multi-level POI is equipped with a Buy Station, Ammo Cache, UAV Tower, and a limited use POI wide gas decontamination system. It’s the only POI on Fortune’s Keep that maintains a UAV Tower which makes it an incredibly desirable location for tracking enemy movement. When inland, watch for snipers firing from the deck.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Micro POI Updates[/h3][p] [/p][p]Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9751ae3ad4654c5fc4f9e8bb0557f716c9a6171.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head to the Bay POI to visit Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory located right on the boat launch. The two-story building features the latest in marine research, though in the midst of battle, keep your eyes peeled for enemies making their way into the main structure. With a staircase on either side and an assortment of tightly packed rooms, combat can erupt at any moment.[/p][p][/p][p]For a simpler cover point, move into one of the smaller research center outbuildings, one positioned on the water by the boat launch ramp and the other above the main building for a more elevated vantage point. [/p][p] [/p][p]Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c66e8e7df5d69f77d57077bdd68c073e44e11a75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Between the Pier and Lighthouse now stands the fast-food restaurant, Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus. Stop in for some grub straight from the shoreline, from Bubby’s Up-Chunk Chowder to Smothered Seagull Cutlet. The one-story building marks a strong cover point in the area. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/887b4b0f6c08ba5f52fff33e6e61842018a5c834.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fire out the windows on enemy targets in the surrounding lot or get behind the service counter for defending against enemies attempting to breach the building.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler HQ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1b4eda4c41b00a821e066a9cc87562ea077157a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned right near the opening of the Grotto near the Gatehouse, the Smuggler HQ offers a valuable looting and cover point positioned right in the center of the map. Use the cluster of buildings and shipping containers to get out of sight from the main roads, resupply, and ambush unsuspecting passersby. The centrally located POI offers a great pivot point toward other areas of the map, whether your squad’s planning an attack toward the northern Keep or elsewhere on the island.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Modes and Weekend LTMS (Launch, Mid-Season)[/h3][p] [/p][p]Clash (Launch)[/p][p][i]52v52, Verdansk, Returning[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/61c2144149030a721793d41d07da1739baa04757.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Prepare for a largescale team skirmish in the 52v52 Clash Mode, with the battle location taking place in one of nine POIs within Verdansk, including the returning POIs Farm, Promenade East, Quarry, and Boneyard plus five new Clash zones in Airport, Signal Station, Launch Pad, Port, and Factory.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first team to reach the point limit — or whoever has the highest point total when the match timer runs out — wins the game, with points being allocated as such:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 point per elimination.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 10 points per completed Contract.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 20 points per each bonus crate capture.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 40 points per each Domination point capture.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Get the advantage any way you can, from seeking out vehicles including the new LTV mid-sized truck equipped with a turret, completing Contracts for points and in-match rewards, and building up your cash reserves for Buy Station purchases like the Death Machine, D.A.W.G., and, when it’s time to bring in the big guns, the VTOL Warship. Work with your squad and the greater team to push the fight, capture Domination points, and grind the enemy forces into the dirt.[/p][p] [/p][p]Squad Gun Game (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Resurgence Maps[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Experience Gun Game in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the first time ever as squads drop into Resurgence maps with the objective of being the first to cycle through a pre-determined number of weapons. Eliminate enemy targets to progress to the next weapon.
